summary: A read of a send found that the message went out, with the moment it went and the provider's identifier for it.

key.description: The work item that made the send: one line per send.

plugin.description: The plugin that answered the read.

reference.description: The provider's reference for the send, as the send returned it.

sent_at.description: When the message went, or null where the provider gives no moment known to be UTC.

message_id.description: The provider's identifier for the message that went, or null where it gives none.

observed_by.description: How the send was found gone: a read of its status.

read_work_item.description: The work item that read the send's status.
